import json,os,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stopping=False
paused=None
pause_started=None
paused_seconds=0.
def request_stop(*_):
    global stopping
    stopping=True
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,request_stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,request_stop)
def read(name):return json.loads((root/name).read_text())
def emit(event,**fields):
    with (root/'resource_pause_events.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(dict(utc=time.time(),event=event,**fields))+'\n')
def identity(spec):
    pid=spec['pid'];p=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
    try:
        fields=(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
        command=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
        return (int(fields[19])==spec['start_ticks'] and p.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
                and b'visuotactile.anchor_continue' in command and b'fresh-train' in command
                and os.fsencode(str(root/'training')) in command)
    except (OSError,ValueError,IndexError):return False
def resume(reason):
    global paused,pause_started,paused_seconds
    if paused is None:return
    spec,fd=paused
    try:
        signal.pidfd_send_signal(fd,signal.SIGCONT)
    except ProcessLookupError:pass
    finally:os.close(fd)
    duration=time.time()-pause_started;paused_seconds+=duration
    emit('resume',pid=spec['pid'],reason=reason,paused_seconds=duration,total_paused_seconds=paused_seconds)
    paused=None;pause_started=None
emit('start',policy='owned trainer only; stop >=45%; resume <=38%; native/schedule/data unchanged')
try:
    while not stopping:
        status=read('status.json');session=read('training/session.json')
        if status['state']!='running' or not status['stage'].startswith('training_'):
            break
        if time.time()>=session['training_deadline']-620:break
        owner=read('active_owner.json');spec=owner['worker']
        if not identity(spec):break
        if paused is not None and paused[0]!=spec:resume('worker changed')
        row=read('resources/resources.json')['latest']
        fresh=time.time()-row['utc_epoch']<5
        rolling=row.get('rolling_60s_percent')
        if not fresh or rolling is None:
            resume('missing telemetry; existing lease handles memory admission')
        elif paused is None and rolling>=45:
            fd=os.pidfd_open(spec['pid'])
            if not identity(spec):os.close(fd);break
            signal.pidfd_send_signal(fd,signal.SIGSTOP)
            paused=(spec,fd);pause_started=time.time()
            emit('pause',pid=spec['pid'],rolling_60s_percent=rolling)
        elif paused is not None and rolling<=38:
            resume('whole card <=38%')
        out=dict(utc=time.time(),pid=os.getpid(),worker=spec['pid'],paused=paused is not None,
                 current_pause_seconds=time.time()-pause_started if paused else 0.,
                 completed_pause_seconds=paused_seconds,rolling_60s_percent=rolling)
        temp=root/'resource_pause_status.tmp';temp.write_text(json.dumps(out));temp.replace(root/'resource_pause_status.json')
        time.sleep(1)
finally:
    resume('guard exit')
    emit('exit',total_paused_seconds=paused_seconds)

runtime_pacing_lock_revision.script:
import fcntl,json,os,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stopping=False
held=False
pause_started=None
paused_seconds=0.
def request_stop(*_):
    global stopping
    stopping=True
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,request_stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,request_stop)
def read(name):return json.loads((root/name).read_text())
def emit(event,**fields):
    with (root/'resource_pause_events.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(dict(utc=time.time(),version=2,event=event,**fields))+'\n')
def identity(spec):
    p=Path('/proc')/str(spec['pid'])
    try:
        fields=(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split();command=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
        return (int(fields[19])==spec['start_ticks'] and p.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
                and b'visuotactile.anchor_continue' in command and b'fresh-train' in command
                and os.fsencode(str(root/'training')) in command)
    except (OSError,ValueError,IndexError):return False
lock=(root/'gpu.lock').open('a')
def release(reason):
    global held,pause_started,paused_seconds
    if not held:return
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    duration=time.time()-pause_started;paused_seconds+=duration
    emit('resume',reason=reason,paused_seconds=duration,total_paused_seconds=paused_seconds)
    held=False;pause_started=None
emit('start',policy='Existing gpu.lock; no trainer signals; pause >=45%; resume <=38%')
try:
    while not stopping:
        status=read('status.json');session=read('training/session.json')
        if status['state']!='running' or not status['stage'].startswith('training_'):break
        if time.time()>=session['training_deadline']-620:break
        spec=read('active_owner.json')['worker']
        if not identity(spec):break
        row=read('resources/resources.json')['latest'];rolling=row.get('rolling_60s_percent')
        if time.time()-row['utc_epoch']>=5 or rolling is None:
            release('missing telemetry; native lease retains its own admission')
        elif not held and rolling>=45:
            try:fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            except BlockingIOError:pass
            else:
                held=True;pause_started=time.time();emit('pause',pid=spec['pid'],rolling_60s_percent=rolling)
        elif held and rolling<=38:release('whole card <=38%')
        out=dict(utc=time.time(),version=2,pid=os.getpid(),worker=spec['pid'],paused=held,
                 current_pause_seconds=time.time()-pause_started if held else 0.,
                 completed_pause_seconds=paused_seconds,rolling_60s_percent=rolling,
                 mechanism='existing gpu.lock; waiting outside measured work')
        temp=root/'resource_pause_status.tmp';temp.write_text(json.dumps(out));temp.replace(root/'resource_pause_status.json')
        time.sleep(.25)
finally:
    release('guard exit');lock.close();emit('exit',total_paused_seconds=paused_seconds)
